info.title: CF Meet Messaging API
info.description: HTTP surface of services/messaging: GET /health, /ready, /openapi.json (public, no data); the customer API under /v1/messaging and /v1/conversations (CF Meet API credential verified by Platform Access — afresh for every mutation; a verified acting principal; 503 when Platform Access is unreachable — fail closed; client tokens are accepted only on the member operations whose security lists clientToken (elsewhere 401 CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED); the device-direct realtime routes /v1/realtime/tickets (client token) and /v1/realtime (WebSocket, single-use ticket) authenticate themselves). /internal/v1/** is service-authenticated and exposes no operation yet. Request bodies are limited to 512 KiB. 1.13.0: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}/thread (thread summary); pin expiry; conversation retentionSeconds / expiryGraceSeconds.

get.description: Liveness only.
Readiness: database reachable and every migration applied (503 otherwise). No secret or connection detail.
This document.

post.description: Scope messages.send. Registers the device by its registration KeyPackage: RFC 9420 validation, the server-assigned credential identity and the signed challenge binding prove possession of the device key and freshness. Stores PUBLIC material only, appends a transparency leaf. Replaying the same answer returns the device (200).

post.description: Scope conversations.create; the acting principal becomes the owner. Context class and security profile are checked against the persisted effective policy: the profile defaults to the context's default (PRIVATE_E2EE where eligible), MANAGED only where the application policy allows it, never a silent fallback (E2EE_NOT_AVAILABLE when encryption cannot be established). DIRECT conversations are deduplicated per principal pair and profile; a live context reference is unique. Idempotency-Key replays the stored response (200).

post.description: Scope messages.send. An upload intent (signed PUT of exactly size bytes with that SHA-256) for the acting principal's own ACTIVE device; at most 3 unfinished intents; size ≤ backups.maxBytes (413 BACKUP_TOO_LARGE). Opt-in secure backups (Appendix I.3): the object is encrypted on the client with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key, a recovery code or content and cannot decrypt the object. Only the acting principal's own backups; another principal's are NOT_FOUND. Refused while backups.enabled is false (503 FEATURE_DISABLED BACKUPS_DISABLED) or the BACKUPS kill switch is engaged.

Verifies the uploaded object (size, SHA-256, format magic, header principal = acting principal); READY on success (idempotent), else REJECTED with 422 INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED (SIZE_MISMATCH, DIGEST_MISMATCH, NOT_A_BACKUP, WRONG_PRINCIPAL) and the object is deleted. Keeps the newest backups.retainCount READY backups. Opt-in secure backups (Appendix I.3): the object is encrypted on the client with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key, a recovery code or content and cannot decrypt the object. Only the acting principal's own backups; another principal's are NOT_FOUND. Refused while backups.enabled is false (503 FEATURE_DISABLED BACKUPS_DISABLED) or the BACKUPS kill switch is engaged.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The verified acting principal (Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE in the credential's environment).

post.description: Scope messages.read. A short-lived signed read of a READY backup object (409 BACKUP_NOT_READY otherwise). Opt-in secure backups (Appendix I.3): the object is encrypted on the client with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key, a recovery code or content and cannot decrypt the object. Only the acting principal's own backups; another principal's are NOT_FOUND. Refused while backups.enabled is false (503 FEATURE_DISABLED BACKUPS_DISABLED) or the BACKUPS kill switch is engaged.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The verified acting principal (Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE in the credential's environment).

get.description: Scope messages.read (members, within their history window). The thread rooted at messageId: reply count, last reply sequence / time and the caller's unread replies (after their read cursor). With threads turned off by policy no reply records a thread root, so the count is 0.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The verified acting principal (Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE in the credential's environment).

customerCredential.description: A CF Meet API credential, verified by Platform Access (never by Messaging).

clientToken.name: Authorization
clientToken.description: CF-Client-Token <Messaging Client Access Token> (device-direct, §105). Accepted by POST /v1/realtime/tickets and, as an alternative to customerCredential, by the member operations that list it: the token's session (device ACTIVE, session ACTIVE and unexpired, principal ACTIVE) is the caller, acting only for its own principal and own device (CF-Acting-Principal may only repeat it). Every other operation answers 401 CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED.

realtimeTicket.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
realtimeTicket.description: `cfmeet.messaging.v1, cfmeet.ticket.<ticket>`: the single-use ticket travels as a subprotocol entry; the server answers `cfmeet.messaging.v1` only.

centralArchiveRequired.description: Only MANAGED is allowed (allowedProfiles must be [MANAGED]); an E2EE conversation can never be archived by the server.

exportsEnabled.description: Requires MANAGED; the server never exports E2EE plaintext.

smsBridgeEligible.description: Requires MANAGED among allowedProfiles; SMS is never end-to-end encrypted.

messaging.common.v1.ApplicationPolicy.description: An application environment's overrides of the platform defaults. MANAGED is available for a context only when listed here.

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

derivatives.description: Server-made derivatives (metadata reads only; empty for PRIVATE_E2EE).

messaging.common.v1.Attachment.description: An attachment's authorized metadata and lifecycle. Bytes live in protected object storage under a server-generated key.

status.description: QUOTA_DEFERRED: the environment's storage budget has no room for the thumbnail. No object is stored or charged; the original attachment is unaffected; the derivative is retried later or when the attachment policy changes (errorCode STORAGE_BUDGET).

size.description: The stored object's actual bytes (THUMBNAIL), charged to the environment's storage budget alongside the original.

metadata.description: INSPECTION only: the measured facts (null for THUMBNAIL and until READY).

messaging.common.v1.AttachmentDerivative.description: A server-made derivative of a MANAGED attachment: a re-encoded PNG thumbnail of an image without the original's metadata (THUMBNAIL), or the measured container, duration and dimensions of an image, voice note or video (INSPECTION, no object). Never produced for PRIVATE_E2EE attachments, whose thumbnails the sending client encrypts itself.

residualAccessSeconds.description: A grant issued before a revocation stays usable at most this long; GET .../content re-checks authorization on every request.

messaging.common.v1.AttachmentDownloadGr.description: A short-lived signed read of one object forcing Content-Disposition: attachment and the stored content type. Issued only after authorization (current membership, history window, message ACTIVE, attachment READY).

mediaType.description: MANAGED: required, in the kind's allow-list. PRIVATE_E2EE: omit (or application/octet-stream).

deviceId.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the uploading device (the acting principal's).

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

messaging.common.v1.Backup.description: Metadata of an opaque backup object. keyId and clientBackupId come from the object's public header; the server cannot decrypt the object.

messaging.common.v1.BackupIntentRequest.description: An upload intent for one client-encrypted backup object (Appendix I.3). The client encrypts with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key or content.

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

messaging.common.v1.ClientToken.description: A short-lived Messaging Client Access Token (compact JWS, EdDSA, typ cfmeet-mcat+jwt) bound to tenant, application, environment, principal, device and session. Device-direct use only: POST /v1/realtime/tickets.

messaging.common.v1.CommitRequest.description: An MLS Commit created in the group's current epoch. removedDeviceIds is the committer's attestation of the leaves it removes; while removals are pending it must cover them all.

messaging.common.v1.ContextClass.description: Generic context classes; a product's order, trip, consultation or case is only an opaque ContextRef.

messaging.common.v1.ContextRef.description: An opaque reference in the application's own namespace. Never authority, never a membership grant.

members.description: The first 100 ACTIVE members (owner, administrators, then members); page through GET /v1/conversations/{id}/members for the rest (membersTruncated).

messaging.common.v1.Conversation.description: The canonical Conversation aggregate. PRIVATE_E2EE: MLS 1.0 with the server-assigned 32-byte MLS group id; serverCanReadContent is false. MANAGED: no MLS binding; serverCanReadContent is true.

data.description: camelCase payload; message events carry the message's CURRENT representation (a deleted message replays as a tombstone).

messaging.common.v1.ConversationEvent.description: A durable conversation event (derived from committed state, replayable by its per-conversation eventSequence). Every durable event names its tenant, application and environment (§117).

managedDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Regulated contexts: creating a MANAGED conversation requires acknowledging that the server can read its content (refused otherwise with MANAGED_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED).

expiryGraceSeconds.description: §38: requires an expiring conversation. Past expiresAt the conversation refuses new messages (CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE / EXPIRED) but stays readable and extendable for this many seconds before it becomes EXPIRED.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited.

messaging.common.v1.CreateConversationRe.description: A tenant / application / environment is never part of a request: it comes from the authenticated credential.

messaging.common.v1.CreateSmsBridgeReque.description: Bridge a MANAGED conversation to one external party by SMS. The number is passed to the SMS Gateway once and never stored by Messaging. A PRIVATE_E2EE conversation is never bridged (E2EE_CONVERSATION_NOT_BRIDGEABLE).

messaging.common.v1.DeletionRequest.description: Legal holds win: held items are preserved and counted (PARTIALLY_HELD).

signaturePublicKey.description: base64url Ed25519 MLS signature PUBLIC key (32 bytes).

messaging.common.v1.Device.description: A Messaging device: PUBLIC key material only (never a private key).

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

expectedEditCount.description: Optimistic version check: the editCount the editor last saw. If another edit committed first the request is refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT (reason EDITED_CONCURRENTLY). Omitted: last writer wins.

smsBridgeEligible.description: A MANAGED conversation of this context may be bridged to SMS (default: whenever MANAGED is allowed; never for an E2EE-only context).

messages.description: Message features (platform policy version 4). Replies are always supported; a tenant may turn threads off (replies are kept without a thread root), reactions or pins.

deliveryReceipts.description: Other members learn when a message was DELIVERED to a recipient (messaging.delivery-cursor.updated / delivery-cursor.updated events).

revisionHistoryVisible.description: Members may read the kept revisions of edited MANAGED messages. Revisions are always kept (exports and legal holds include them).

messaging.common.v1.EffectivePolicy.description: Platform defaults merged with the application's overrides (deterministic; stored as an immutable content-addressed snapshot). Platform policy version 3 (Parts E-G): attachments (off by default), editing windows, privacy of presence / typing / read receipts, retention, moderation, abuse limits; regulated context controls.

messaging.common.v1.Error.description: Error envelope. Messages never contain key material, ciphertext, content, a credential or database text.

syncRequired.description: The requested position is older than the retained event window: resynchronize messages by sequence.

messaging.common.v1.HistoryTransfer.description: A device-to-device history transfer. Messaging relays an opaque sealed history between two ACTIVE devices of one principal; it holds no key that opens it (no recovery key, no escrow) and deletes the sealed bytes on completion, cancellation, revocation or expiry.

transferPublicKey.description: base64url X25519 HPKE public key (32 bytes) generated by the TARGET device for this transfer only.

expiresAt.description: At most one hour from now (whole seconds are signed).

requestSignature.description: Ed25519 signature by the TARGET device key over packages/messaging-crypto history_transfer::request_signing_input.

messaging.common.v1.HistoryTransferReque.description: A new device's request for the history its existing device holds (ADR 0052 AD-07).

messaging.common.v1.LegalHold.description: A legal / compliance hold: held items are never purged or deleted. For PRIVATE_E2EE it preserves ciphertext and metadata only; it never creates a decryption capability.

durationMs.description: Measured from the bytes (null: the container records none).

durationMatchesDeclared.description: Declared vs measured within max(1 s, 5 %); null when either is absent.

messaging.common.v1.MediaInspection.description: What the server measured in a READY MANAGED attachment's bytes (never inferred for PRIVATE_E2EE ciphertext).

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

cryptographicRemoval.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the server-side removal is authorization only; a member's MLS commit removing the devices completes the cryptographic exclusion.

e2ee.description: The protected envelope (Appendix H.1): version, protocol, cipher suite and the scope the client bound into the AAD; the server stores and relays the ciphertext without reading it.

securityProvenance.description: NATIVE: created through Messaging. LEGACY_MANAGED: imported from a legacy chat store (MANAGED only, never presented as end-to-end encrypted).

oneOf.description: LEGACY_MANAGED: the original time at the legacy source.

channel.description: IN_APP, or SMS: arrived through the SMS Bridge (MANAGED only; never end-to-end encrypted).

replyToMessageId.description: The message this one replies to (same conversation, within the sender's history window).

threadRootId.description: The root of the reply thread (the first message replied to).

messaging.common.v1.Message.description: A message. Content (ciphertext or MANAGED text) only while ACTIVE. e2ee for PRIVATE_E2EE rows, managed for MANAGED rows; the acceptance digest binds the server sequence and id to the ciphertext (cfmeet-messaging-acceptance:v2).

messaging.common.v1.MessageLifecycle.description: ACTIVE carries content; every other state is a tombstone without content. HIDDEN_FOR_YOU: deleted on the reader's own devices only.

messaging.common.v1.MessageRevisionPage.description: The kept prior versions of a MANAGED message, oldest first (revision n = the text after n edits). Visible to members only when editing.revisionHistoryVisible; empty for a deleted message.

messaging.common.v1.ModerationAction.description: Append-only; audited. No action reads PRIVATE_E2EE content.

messaging.common.v1.PermalinkResolution.description: A permalink is never authority: resolution checks current membership; a non-member and an unknown id are the same NOT_FOUND.

expiresAt.description: §49: optional pin expiry (in the future). An expired pin is no longer listed nor counted toward the limit; pinning again renews it.

messaging.common.v1.PinRequest.description: Optional body of PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/pins/{messageId}; an empty body pins without expiry.

pushDeliveryConfigured.description: false: no push adapter / credentials for this platform in this deployment; jobs end NOT_CONFIGURED (never reported delivered).

messaging.common.v1.RealtimeTicket.description: Single-use, seconds-long WebSocket ticket, presented as a Sec-WebSocket-Protocol entry (never in the URL).

keyPackage.description: base64url of the registration KeyPackage (RFC 9420 MLSMessage, wire format mls_key_package).

registrationBinding.description: The exact RFC 9420 application_id leaf extension the registration KeyPackage must carry.

credentialIdentity.description: The exact BasicCredential identity of every KeyPackage of the device.

messaging.common.v1.RegistrationChalleng.description: A single-use registration challenge with a server-assigned device id.

messaging.common.v1.ReportDetail.description: A report with its evidence (moderation.manage; audited as REPORT_VIEWED).

messaging.common.v1.ReportReceipt.description: What the reporter learns: that the report was received. The reported principal is never told who reported.

disclosure.description: PRIVATE_E2EE only and optional: what the reporter's own device decrypted, disclosed voluntarily (sealed at rest; presented as unverifiable).

sealedHistory.description: base64url of the sealed history: HPKE (RFC 9180) ciphertext to the transfer key, signed by the SOURCE device (history_transfer::seal_history).

messaging.common.v1.SearchResults.description: Server search covers MANAGED conversations only; PRIVATE_E2EE conversations are searched on devices (LOCAL_SEARCH_ONLY).

messaging.common.v1.SecurityProfile.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: client-side MLS 1.0 encryption, the server holds no decryption key. MANAGED: server-processable, never presented as E2EE.

ciphertext.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the MLS PrivateMessage (MLSMessage bytes, base64url). Never plaintext.

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

notify.description: false: no push notification jobs (mirrored / migrated writes). Default true.

managedPresentation.description: MANAGED only (refused for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose presentation travels inside the ciphertext).

messaging.common.v1.SendMessageRequest.description: Which fields apply is decided by the conversation's PERSISTED security profile: PRIVATE_E2EE needs deviceId, epoch and ciphertext and refuses text (CONTENT_REJECTED / PLAINTEXT_IN_E2EE); MANAGED needs text and refuses ciphertext.

messaging.common.v1.SmsBridgeDisclosure.description: Part V H §106: the disclosure a bridge creator must acknowledge (version-pinned).

messaging.common.v1.SmsTransport.description: Carrier state of one bridged message — separate from in-app delivery and read state (§110).

unreadReplyCount.description: Replies from others after the caller's read cursor.

messaging.common.v1.ThreadSummary.description: §47: a thread's reply count, last reply and the caller's unread replies, counted only inside the caller's history window (active, not hidden).

messaging.common.v1.ThumbnailGrant.description: A short-lived read of a MANAGED image's thumbnail, authorized exactly like a download grant of the original.

leafData.description: base64url of the exact leaf bytes the log hashed (canonical JSON).

logId.description: The deployment's key-transparency log (stable across key rotation); signed.

timestamp.description: When this head was produced (RFC 3339, microseconds).

timestampMicros.description: The same instant in Unix microseconds: exactly what the signature covers.

keyId.description: First 8 bytes (hex) of SHA-256 of the log's Ed25519 public key, which clients pin out of band.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-tree-head:v1', logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash and timestampMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::tree_head_signing_input / verify_tree_head_signature (Part V G.5).

witnessStatus.description: WITNESSED only when at least witnessQuorum distinct configured witnesses cosigned exactly this head (verify with packages/messaging-crypto transparency::verify_witnessed_tree_head against witness keys you pin). UNWITNESSED: verifiable but not, by itself, anti-equivocation.

witnessQuorum.description: Distinct witness cosignatures this deployment requires for WITNESSED (0: no witnesses configured).

cosignatures.description: Witness cosignatures of exactly this head (logId, treeSize, rootHash, timestampMicros), each already verified by Messaging under the witness's pinned key; clients verify them again.

messaging.common.v1.TreeHead.description: A SIGNED tree head (Part V G.5) with the cosignatures of independent key-transparency witnesses (AD-05). The log signing key is a server secret distinct from the service-authentication key. A witness cosigns a head only after verifying the log signature and a consistency proof from the last head it cosigned, so a quorum of witnesses prevents the log from showing different views.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited. Only ever tightens (RETENTION_ONLY_TIGHTENS).

messaging.common.v1.UpdateConversationRe.description: Optimistic concurrency on the aggregate version. EXPIRED is set by the server only. A security profile can never be changed (SECURITY_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE).

pricing.description: Messaging records usage facts only; it never prices or bills.

messaging.common.v1.UsageSummary.description: Usage facts of the caller's application environment (Part V I §129): quantities only, no price, rate or cost.

cosignedAtMicros.description: When the witness cosigned (Unix microseconds); signed.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-witness-cosignature:v1', witnessId, logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash, timestampMicros (i64 BE) and cosignedAtMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::witness_cosignature_input.

messaging.common.v1.WitnessCosignature.description: One witness's cosignature of a tree head.

platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.
